description: Revert to the proven 8-layer/128-head architecture with Matrix LR 0.06 and Weight Decay 0.1, which consistently achieved the lowest val_bpb (0.9905) and showed stable convergence, as the previous stabilization attempt (0.055 LR / 0.12 WD) yielded a slightly worse result (0.9902), indicating the model requires slightly more aggressive updates to fully converge within the 5-minute budget.
